name: map-route-shape
question: R8. Rounds 2 and 3 both failed on routes: naming the path's ENDPOINTS gives a dead-straight causeway (u4, u6) or a hedgerow field grid (v4, v5). These cells name the path's SHAPE instead — lazy S, named bends, 'wanders and never runs straight for long', 'meanders around the pools' — and w3-w6 also lead with the TERRAIN rather than the path so the path stops being the subject. Two routes (R2 marsh, R1 meadow) so the winner is not overfitted to one biome. A cell passes if the path is one continuous non-straight line touching two opposite edges, the terrain is the right biome, and there is no grid.
